name: Complete Blood Count with ESR (CBC + ESR)
summary: Counts red cells, white cells and platelets and measures erythrocyte sedimentation rate.

name: Blood Glucose (Fasting, PP or Random)
summary: Measures glucose in plasma at a specified collection time.

name: Glycated Haemoglobin (HbA1c)
summary: Estimates average blood-glucose exposure over roughly the preceding 2–3 months.

name: Lipid Profile
summary: Assesses cholesterol fractions and triglycerides to support cardiovascular risk assessment.

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
summary: Panel listed as ALT, AST, ALP, GGT, total/direct bilirubin, albumin and protein.

name: Serum Creatinine
summary: Measures blood creatinine, which is commonly used to estimate kidney filtration (eGFR).

name: Blood Urea / BUN
summary: Measures urea nitrogen or urea in blood; reporting units vary by laboratory.

name: Urine Routine & Microscopy
summary: Checks urine chemistry and microscopic elements such as red/white cells, crystals and casts.

name: Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
summary: Measures TSH, a pituitary hormone used to assess thyroid regulation.

name: Thyroid Function Test (Total T3, T4 & TSH)
summary: Measures total T3, total T4 and TSH as listed in the offer.

name: Serum Electrolytes (Na, K, Cl)
summary: Measures sodium, potassium and chloride in blood.

name: ABO Blood Group & Rh Typing
summary: Determines ABO blood group and RhD status.

name: Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy
summary: Measures serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D, the usual marker of vitamin D status.

name: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin)
summary: Measures vitamin B12 in serum.

name: Serum Ferritin
summary: Measures ferritin, a marker of iron stores that can also rise with inflammation.

name: Iron Studies (Iron, TIBC, Saturation)
summary: Measures iron, iron-binding capacity and calculated transferrin saturation as listed.

name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP), Quantitative
summary: Measures C-reactive protein, a nonspecific inflammatory marker.

name: Serum Uric Acid
summary: Measures urate in blood.

name: Serum Calcium, Total
summary: Measures total blood calcium, including protein-bound and free calcium.

name: Serum Phosphate
summary: Measures inorganic phosphate in blood.

name: Total Immunoglobulin E (IgE)
summary: Measures total IgE concentration in serum.

name: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)
summary: Detects hepatitis B surface antigen in blood.

name: Hepatitis C Antibody (Anti-HCV)
summary: Detects antibodies to hepatitis C virus.

name: HIV 1/2 Antigen-Antibody, Fourth Generation
summary: Screens for HIV-1/2 antibodies and p24 antigen using a fourth-generation assay.

name: Dengue NS1 Antigen & IgM/IgG Antibodies (ELISA)
summary: Tests dengue NS1 antigen and dengue IgM/IgG antibodies as listed in the combination offer.

name: Malaria Rapid Antigen (HRP2/pLDH)
summary: Uses rapid antigens to support detection of malaria parasites.

name: Prothrombin Time / INR
summary: Measures clotting time via the extrinsic pathway and reports INR where applicable.

name: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT)
summary: Measures clotting time through the intrinsic/common pathways.

name: D-Dimer
summary: Measures fibrin breakdown products in blood.

name: Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH)
summary: Measures LDH, an enzyme found in many tissues.

name: Serum Amylase
summary: Measures serum amylase enzyme activity.

name: Serum Lipase
summary: Measures lipase enzyme activity.

name: Creatine Phosphokinase (CK/CPK), Total
summary: Measures total creatine kinase enzyme activity.

name: Rheumatoid Factor (RF)
summary: Measures rheumatoid factor antibodies.

name: Anti-Streptolysin O (ASO) Titre
summary: Measures antibodies against streptolysin O following group A streptococcal exposure.

name: Serum Prolactin
summary: Measures prolactin hormone in blood.

name: Follicle-Stimulating Hormone (FSH)
summary: Measures pituitary follicle-stimulating hormone.

name: Luteinising Hormone (LH)
summary: Measures pituitary luteinising hormone.

name: Total Testosterone
summary: Measures total testosterone including protein-bound hormone.

name: Beta hCG (Quantitative)
summary: Measures beta human chorionic gonadotropin in blood.

name: Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA)
summary: Measures CEA, a tumour-associated marker used mainly in specified monitoring contexts.

name: Cancer Antigen 125 (CA-125)
summary: Measures CA-125 protein in blood.

name: Urine Albumin-Creatinine Ratio (ACR)
summary: Measures urinary albumin relative to creatinine to assess albumin leakage.

name: Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA), Total
summary: Measures total PSA in blood.

name: Folic Acid (Serum Folate)
summary: Measures folate concentration in serum.

name: VDRL Test
summary: Performs a non-treponemal serological test used in syphilis evaluation.

name: TyphiDot IgM/IgG
summary: Detects IgM/IgG antibodies related to Salmonella Typhi.

name: Thyroid Function Panel (Free T3, Free T4, TSH)
summary: Measures free T3, free T4 and TSH.

name: Platelet Count
summary: Counts platelets in blood.

name: Haemoglobin (Hb)
summary: Measures haemoglobin concentration in blood.

name: Complete Haemogram (CBC, ESR & Peripheral Smear)
summary: Combines CBC, ESR and peripheral-smear examination as advertised.

name: Absolute Eosinophil Count (AEC)
summary: Measures absolute eosinophil concentration in blood.

name: Bilirubin, Total & Direct
summary: Measures total and direct bilirubin; indirect may be calculated from the difference.

name: Serum Magnesium
summary: Measures magnesium concentration in blood.

name: Serum Iron
summary: Measures circulating serum iron concentration.

name: Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT / SGPT)
summary: Measures ALT enzyme activity in blood.

name: Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST / SGOT)
summary: Measures AST enzyme activity in blood.

name: Anti-Thyroid Peroxidase Antibodies (Anti-TPO)
summary: Measures antibodies against thyroid peroxidase.

name: Potassium (Serum / Plasma)
summary: Measures potassium electrolyte concentration.

name: Renal Profile (Urea, Creatinine, Uric Acid, Electrolytes)
summary: Panel advertised as urea, creatinine, uric acid and electrolytes.

name: LDL Cholesterol, Direct
summary: Directly measures low-density lipoprotein cholesterol.

name: Troponin I, Quantitative
summary: Measures cardiac troponin I concentration.

name: Serum Cortisol (AM / PM)
summary: Measures cortisol at a specified morning or evening collection time.

name: Gamma-Glutamyl Transferase (GGT)
summary: Measures GGT enzyme activity in blood.

name: Serum Total Protein
summary: Measures total serum protein, mainly albumin and globulins.

name: Ionised Calcium
summary: Measures physiologically active unbound calcium in blood.
